construction: Lambda_C = {x in Z^40 : x mod 2 in C_2(W)}; Theta = W_C(f0,f1)
reading: The Construction A lattice of the doubly-even self-orthogonal code C_2(W) is an even rank-40 lattice whose theta series is a weight-20 modular form, computed exactly from the [40,16,8] weight enumerator via W_C(theta3,theta2) (Gleason / Broue-Enguehard). This completes the W(3,3) arithmetic tower: graph -> zeta/class group -> code -> lattice + modular form.
literature: Broue-Enguehard maps; Gleason's theorem (modular forms from codes)
